title: Why “amd share price” is trending in MY: 100+ searches, the facts (November 21, 2026)
description: “amd share price” is trending in MY with 100+ searches reported by Google. The verified coverage behind the spike, from CNBC and 2 more.

sections.heading: What is trending: “amd share price”
paragraphs: “amd share price” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for MY (snapshot taken 2026-11-21T01:35:26+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 100 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from CNBC, Free Malaysia Today, South China Morning Post. The headlines, exactly as published:
list: “AMD dives on short seller report of alleged China exposure” — CNBC
“After Nvidia, will AMD be a target as China’s ‘2nd-choice’ supplier for AI chips?” — South China Morning Post
“AMD slides after report links its chips to blacklisted Chinese firm” — Free Malaysia Today

sections.heading: Timeline
paragraphs: The trend entry was published to the Google Trends feed at Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:50:00 -0800. Our snapshot was taken at 2026-11-21T01:35:26+00:00 UTC and this briefing was assembled at 2026-11-21T01:35:58+00:00 UTC.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
